top_signals.title: Trafigura Snaps Up Copper in Asia as China Faces Supply Crunch
top_signals.summary: Trafigura Group has been buying large volumes of copper to boost sales into Asia as local supplies run low, adding to a scramble for metal that’s pushed regional premiums for spot cargoes to record highs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
